properties.name: CR-0 remaining research requirement
properties.remaining_requirement: Actual TS/Effect-to-Lean refinement, LLM stochastic realization, and rights/observation semantics remain open.

properties.name: CR-1 remaining research requirement
properties.remaining_requirement: Fresh held-out prediction/control improvement from outcome-conditioned semantic revision; equal-information baselines.

properties.name: CR-2 remaining research requirement
properties.remaining_requirement: An identifying observation/intervention family; external outcome truth and causal relation interpretation.

properties.name: CR-3 remaining research requirement
properties.remaining_requirement: Joint causal credit under shared causes, delayed feedback and overlapping participants without double counting.

properties.name: CR-4 remaining research requirement
properties.remaining_requirement: Learn new meaningful variables, typed relations and useful topology; fixed-role content revision alone is insufficient.

properties.name: CR-5 remaining research requirement
properties.remaining_requirement: World/self readout continuity and useful persistent change beyond content durability.

properties.name: CR-6 remaining research requirement
properties.remaining_requirement: Joint Step and Learn preservation, uncertainties and exceptions under recursive cognition-bearing composition.

properties.name: CR-7 remaining research requirement
properties.remaining_requirement: Construct integrated bounded recursive HSWM under original success criteria; no upstream failure rescued by scale.
